digests.title: La semana en ITBA
digests.subtitle: CEITBA's weekly email digest: last week's articles and next week's events from every organization. Everyone gets the same email; it goes to people who follow CEITBA with the email turned on. Every Monday at 00:05 a draft for the previous week is created, and it goes out automatically at 12:00 (Argentina time) unless you cancel it or turn auto-send off.
